Name: Junimos Accept Cash - 1.6 UI Scale Fix (Unofficial)
Author: wind0nd
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Junimos Accept Cash[/b][/size]
Buy Community Center bundles with gold — updated for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/center]

[b]Junimos Accept Cash[/b] adds a purchase button to Junimo bundle pages. Instead of hunting down every ingredient, you can pay gold to fill the remaining slots of a bundle.

--------------------

[size=5][b]What's changed in this unofficial update[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.[/*]
[*]Fixed the purchase button click handling at different UI scale / zoom settings.[/*]
[*]Added Generic Mod Config Menu support with a configurable cost multiplier.[/*]
[*]Fixed matching for category ingredients (e.g. "any fish") and partially filled bundles.[/*]
[*]Gold is now charged before the bundle is completed, and refunded if completion fails.[/*]
[*]Added a clearer purchase log and less console spam.[/*]
[/list]
--------------------

[size=5][b]How it works[/b][/size]

Open any Community Center bundle page. If the bundle is not already completed and has empty slots, a purchase button appears in the upper-right corner of the page.

The price is calculated from the missing ingredients:

[b]cost = sum(item sell price × required stack) × cost multiplier[/b]

The default multiplier is 10. You can change it from 1 to 100 in Generic Mod Config Menu.

Clicking the button:
[list]
[*]Fills the empty slots with the required items.[/*]
[*]Deducts the gold.[/*]
[*]Completes the bundle through the normal Junimo Note logic, so rewards are granted as usual.[/*]
[/list]
The button is hidden for bundles that already have the vanilla purchase option, and for bundles with no empty slots.

--------------------

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended. The only option is:

[b]Cost Multiplier[/b] — multiplies the calculated gold cost. Default 10, range 1–100.

You can also edit [b]config.json[/b] after the first launch.

--------------------

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Optional: configure the cost multiplier in Generic Mod Config Menu.
